caption: The dry run of the Bell circuit in 1024 shots: each row is one bitstring, with its ideal probability P(b) and the expected count 1024 × P(b). Only 00 and 11 survive, each near 512; a real run wobbles around these two numbers.

spec.title: 1024 shots: P(b) → expected count
spec.aria: A four-row table of the Bell circuit's bitstrings 00, 01, 10 and 11 over 1024 shots, giving probability 1/2 and expected count 512 for 00, probability 0 and count 0 for 01, probability 0 and count 0 for 10, and probability 1/2 and expected count 512 for 11.
